items.name: autocomplete
items.title: Autocomplete
items.description: Free-text input with a suggestion popup on Base UI Autocomplete: filtering list, empty state, groups, clear and trigger; rows use the YoRHa dark wipe, arrow cursor and square bullet. IME-safe: Enter during composition never commits.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Compose Autocomplete > AutocompleteInputGroup (AutocompleteInput, AutocompleteClear, AutocompleteTrigger) and AutocompleteContent > AutocompleteEmpty + AutocompleteList > AutocompleteItem. Optional: AutocompleteGroup/GroupLabel/Separator, Status, Row, Collection, Backdrop, Arrow, Value, useAutocompleteFilter. The typed text is the value; `mode` and `autoHighlight` come from Base UI. Always give the input an aria-label or a label.
